neutral.title: Нейтральная основа
neutral.events: Quiet breathing, one blink, tiny delayed ear follow-through; frame 0 is the untouched neutral expression.

003.title: Смех
003.events: 0–24 anticipation; 30–116 three laughter pulses with closed smiling eyes and springing ears; 120–160 settle; circular paws lift beside the cheeks. No mouth or eyebrows.

016.title: Подмигивание
016.events: 0–34 glance and 18-degree surface turn; 40–74 left wink; 88–108 second smaller wink; 120–156 return; near paw lifts to cheek, far paw counterbalances. No mouth or eyebrows.

054.title: Злость
054.events: 0–24 stare; 28–50 compression; 54–80 upward huff; 92–120 second smaller huff; 126–158 settle; fists tuck in and feet brace.

089.title: Сонное потягивание
089.events: 0–30 heavy blink; 32–68 slow inhale and stretch; 70–114 sleepy hold; 116–150 release and sleepy blink; 152–180 settle. Full-body paw rubs the cheek; head version uses drooping ears and heavy eyelids. No mouth or eyebrows.
